cross_cutting_mbo_finding: THE PRE-PRINT DE-RISK LEG IS THE PRINT DAY. Decomposing every G20 session on the ET clock (prior close -> 06:00 -> 10:30 -> 12:30 -> close) shows the 06:00-10:30 pre-print window carries the largest single leg on 8 of 10 days, and on BOTH EIA Thursdays it is the two largest positive readings in the whole block: 20260528 +1060 of a +2100 day, 20260604 +1030 of a +1130 day (on 0604 the pre-print leg is 91% of the entire day-move and the 10:30-12:30 print window added only +120). Both Thursdays ran a NEGATIVE overnight leg first (-170, -70) - which the blind reproduced correctly - and then the blind truncated the 06:00-10:30 leg to near zero. That single missing leg is 2090 of my 3530 USD of blind error. MECHANISM (general, not day-specific): a crowded short that is still ADDING must de-risk before a scheduled binary; that de-risking is continuous, it is dated to the session's first genuinely liquid window (06:00-10:30 ET), and it is NOT dated to the catalyst. The brain already names this repricing window - structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell literally says 'reprices UP on the Monday catch-up (weekend gap and/or 06-10 window)' - but scopes it to the WEEKEND SEAM. G20 says it is not seam-specific: it fires on any session carrying a scheduled binary, and an EIA print is a seam in information exactly as a weekend is a seam in time. This also GENERALIZES timing.catalyst_continuity_frontrun, which today requires a LIVE CONTINUOUS weather ramp to license front-running a scheduled event. There is no live cold ramp here (gw_hdd 0.28-0.88, deep shoulder) and the front-run fired anyway on both Thursdays. The correct statement of the driver is broader: A POSITIONING EXTREME IS ITSELF A CONTINUOUS CATALYST. Forward test: on every print day with COT MM 1y-pctile <= ~16 and a non-improving WoW delta, expect a 06:00-10:30 covering leg of ~1.3x n0_net_sigma_5 SIGNED TOWARD THE CROWDED SIDE'S EXIT, sized independently of, and emitted before, any view on the print itself.  ||  WHY THE BLOCK LEAN SURVIVED THE CUM-0 FIX. The framing is right that the G19 chain-state bug is fixed and behaving, so the lean has another root, and my two days sit on it: the blind is still consuming SESSION SIGNED FLOW AS DIRECTION. Across G20, sign(total_sflow) agrees with sign(day_move) on only 4 of 10 days, and it DISAGREES on 4 of the 5 largest-|sflow| sessions (0604 -5662/+1140, 0527 -4910/+620, 0601 +3796/-1680, 0602 +3524/-70). Signed flow in this block is INVERTED, and the inversion STRENGTHENS with magnitude - because at a 0.94-percentile spec short the aggressor is a loaded spec adding to a losing position and the resting side is the one with capital. Net signed flow was negative on 7 of 10 days while the block rallied +1860. The brain already carries the correction at 0.85-0.86 confidence (flow_conviction_sign_gate, absorption_is_reversal: 'absorbed sell -> UP ... on EIA prints this outranks both the surprise sign and the D-1 trade tilt'); it was simply not applied in the blind's direction step. That is a REASONING failure, and no restored data block would have fixed it.  ||  THE THURSDAY STACK IS ALL VETOES AND NO GENERATOR. I ran daytype.eia_preprint_overextension_gate honestly on both my days. 0528: (a) over-extension NO (same-side run 1 day, +610 < ~900), (b) incoherent D-1 flow YES (0527 session_b_share 0.448 vs big_print_b_share 0.529 straddle 0.50 in opposite directions, and prior-close price +610 vs signed flow -4910 disagree), (c) surprise priced NO. 0604: (a) NO (+670 over two days), (b) YES (0603 b-shares 0.451/0.476 both sell-lean against a +750 close and -2852 flow), (c) NO. One of three fires on each - BELOW the 2-of-3 bar, so the gate EXPLICITLY SPARED the full chain-sided band on both days, and the blind still emitted +150 and -450. The gate is a veto; it cannot generate. Same for shoulder_counter_print_damping, big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard and covering_extension_distribution_flip - the Thursday stack is rich in things that can withhold a band and thin in anything that produces one, so when every veto stands down the specialist falls back to the blind's chain drift, which in G20 was down. That is the structural shape of the -2560 forward-curve error, and the pre-print de-risk leg above is offered as the missing GENERATOR.  ||  A SCOPED CORRECTION I OWE covering_extension_distribution_flip. Its PRE-WARNING clause ('a rally day whose SESSION conviction is negative is a terminal-squeeze signature - kill the covering-UP prior for the next extended session') fires on 0603 (-2852 flow / +760 price) and would have killed my 0604 UP - wrongly, 0604 was +1130. It then fires again on 0604 (-5662 / +1140) and is RIGHT: 0605 was -1340. The discriminator between the two is the calendar, not the tape: 0604 carries a scheduled catalyst that forces the pre-print de-risk leg, 0605 does not. Proposed scope refinement: SUSPEND the terminal-squeeze pre-warning for a session carrying a scheduled binary, and resume it the session after. n=2 in-block, cheap to test forward, and it explains 0605 (not my day) without my claiming it.  ||  ATTRIBUTION - RESTORED DATA vs REASONING. weather (was EMPTY 10/10 for the blind, now 10/10): contributed ZERO directional authority on my days and I am not banking it. It CONFIRMED my blind-round stand-down rather than reversing it - the D+0 CDD run-delta signs my two days OPPOSITELY (-0.334 on 0528 which rallied +2100, +0.267 on 0604 which rallied +1130) and the 06Z open cycle available at 08:00 ET, i.e. INSIDE the pre-print window, reads -0.289 HDD on 0528 and -0.003 on 0604, so it cannot be the pre-print leg's driver either. The one thing the restored block DID change is symmetric and negative: with gw_cdd 5.8 -> 9.4 and the forward CDD building to 10.6 at h+1, the S1-void test used by magnitude.shoulder_counter_print_damping is measured in gw-HDD ONLY and therefore reads 'void' mechanically through an entire summer. I extrapolate no CDD amplifier (off-sample, brain scope records no CDD>3 in the walk) and I equally refuse the HDD-keyed DAMPER - the stand-down must be symmetric. On 0604 that is worth ~800 USD, because the damper would have pinned a +1130 day at 0..+300. Net: weather earned 0 for direction and its only magnitude effect was to REMOVE a damper. vol_regime (was a hollow shell 10/10, now 40 fields at the 20260522 vintage): this IS the magnitude scale on both days and I say so plainly - n0_net_sigma_5 737, n0_range_20_mean 1094, n0_range_20_max 2020, n0_range_pctile 81.7, n0_activity_trend 1.619 (an expanding-vol regime) are what turn 'up' into a number. Without it the blind sized off nothing. SPLIT: 0528 is a pure MAGNITUDE repair on a direction the blind already had - roughly 55% restored vol_regime (the scale) and 45% my reasoning (the leg decomposition and the aligned-delivery print multiplier); I am NOT claiming the direction. 0604 is a SIGN FLIP, and vol_regime cannot flip a sign - roughly 85-90% reasoning and 10-15% vol_regime for size only. The 0604 flip is driven by `cot` (MM net -134,426, 1y-pctile 0.94, 3y-pctile 2.23, WoW -38,123 = shorts STILL ADDING) crossed with the measured phase-2 absorption - and `cot` was fully live for the blind. A brain merge must therefore book 0604 as evidence FOR the reasoning play and NOT as forward evidence earned by the re-stage.
